steps.name: Self-registration of verifying authorities
supporting_evidence_quotes: Registration of verifying authorities on Self-registration by verifying authorities on NSP

steps.name: Creation of login credentials for verifying authorities
supporting_evidence_quotes: Creation of login credentials for verifying authorities

steps.name: Metadata updation by institutes
supporting_evidence_quotes: updation of metadata by the institutes (courses, fee etc.) on Portal

steps.name: Institute/School registration request submission
supporting_evidence_quotes: Institutes/Schools desirous to onboard on NSP will make request by filling up a registration form available on NSP.

steps.name: Verification of institute/school details by district/state authority
supporting_evidence_quotes: District authority (for Delhi & U.P. exclusively) or State authority (for all other States/UTs), as the case may be, will verify the details of the Institute/School and accord approval to it.

steps.name: Provision of portal credentials to institute/school
supporting_evidence_quotes: Subsequently, the Institute/School will be added in the database of NSP and will be provided with credentials (login/password) for the Portal.

steps.name: Publicity of scholarship schemes
supporting_evidence_quotes: All participating States/UTs may give wide publicity of the aforesaid three scholarship schemes viz. Pre-Matric, Post Matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarship schemes for minorities and the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) through newspapers, websites, electronic media.

steps.name: Opening of portal for student registration
supporting_evidence_quotes: The Portal will be opened for registration w.e.f. 1st June, 2017 for Pre-Matric, Post- Matric and Merit-cum-Means based scholarship schemes for minorities

steps.name: Student login and application initiation
supporting_evidence_quotes: Students need to apply through the common application form for pre-matric scholarship and another common form for Post Matric & Merit cum Means based scholarships.

steps.name: Instant Aadhaar and bank account verification
supporting_evidence_quotes: An instant verification mechanism for Aadhaar Number Bank account details of the students will be enabled on the Portal.

steps.name: Student fills eligibility details
supporting_evidence_quotes: On successful verification, the students will be allowed to fill up their details essential for establishing their eligibility for scholarships.

steps.name: Portal displays eligible scholarship schemes
supporting_evidence_quotes: The Portal will display a list of schemes for which the student is eligible to apply on the basis of his/her inputs (even non-minority scholarship schemes).

steps.name: Student saves application draft
supporting_evidence_quotes: The Portal will incorporate a provision to save the application before making final submission.
